summary: Phase 3 AI overlay on Comptabilité validated end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passing on /api/acct/ai/{status,config,variance,anomalies,chat,suggest-mapping} using admin creds and latest locked BV period. Frontend: login → nav-acct_dashboard → acct-ai-section visible; ai-config-btn opens ai-config-dialog showing '✅ Actif' with Emergent Universal Key preselected + fields (seuil écart $/%, sensibilité z, modèle). ai-variance-btn generates a real French commentary via ai-variance-text ('MARGE BRUTE - PROJETS' déficit -142 723,88 $ = -45.4%, écart cumulé -1 041 504,55 $ …). ai-chat-input+send returns a factual 6-month charges evolution answer inside ai-chat-messages (2 bubbles). nav-acct_bv → acct-anomalies-card, Détecter renders acct-anomalies-result with AI summary + result table (Distribution aux partenaires z=99, Produits promotionnels z=9.2, etc.). No crashes; graceful-degradation paths (unavailable testids) exist in code. Suggest-mapping tested via backend endpoint (available=true, suggestion returned).

issues: Recurring Recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' still spams console (same as iteration_28) — non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~3162 lines — AI section (2508-2720) is another good candidate for extraction into an ai_router module along with the existing suggestion to split Comptabilité endpoints (from iteration_28).
Comptabilite.js keeps growing (>1100 lines) with new VarianceCard / AiChatPanel / AnomaliesCard components; recommend splitting into /pages/comptabilite/ai/*.js.

ai_service.ai_complete errors on chat/variance surface HTTPException 503 instead of graceful {available:false}. Anomalies handler already swallows AIError; consider aligning variance & chat to the same graceful pattern so a transient LLM outage doesn't 503 the UI.
acct_ai_chat stores every Q/A in acct_ai_chat with no TTL/retention policy — could grow unbounded.
suggest-mapping regex-extracts JSON from a free-form LLM response; on failure returns parsed={} silently — consider surfacing a parse_error flag so the UI can retry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI endpoints: GET /api/acct/ai/status → {configured, enabled, provider, ...}; GET /api/acct/ai/config (admin) redacts secrets; POST /api/acct/ai/variance?year&month → {available, commentary|empty, rows}; POST /api/acct/ai/anomalies?year&month → {available, anomalies[], summary}; POST /api/acct/ai/chat body {session_id, question, year, month} → {available, answer}; GET /api/acct/ai/chat/history?session_id; POST /api/acct/ai/suggest-mapping body {account, name}. Frontend testids: nav-acct_dashboard, nav-acct_bv, acct-ai-section, ai-config-btn, ai-config-dialog, ai-variance-card/-btn/-text/-unavailable, ai-chat-card/-input/-send/-messages, acct-anomalies-card/-btn/-result/-empty/-unavailable/-summary, acct-suggest-<account>. Emergent Universal Key already active in DB (acct_ai_config: enabled=true, provider=emergent, model=gpt-4o).
